Become a part of our caring community
The Software Engineer codes software applications based on business requirements. The Software Engineer work assignments involve moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors.
For new hires, this position is limited to the following approved hiring locations:
Nashville, TN
Louisville, KY
Dallas, TX
Tampa, FL
This role follows a hybrid work model and is not eligible for remote work. Candidates must reside in, or be willing to relocate to, one of the approved locations and work onsite in accordance with team and business requirements.
The Software Engineer standardizes the quality assurance procedure for software. Oversees testing and debugging and develops fixes. Research complaints and make necessary adjustments and/or recommendations to resolve complex software related issues. Begins to influence the department's strategy. Makes decisions regarding technical approaches for project components, and work is performed without direction. Exercises considerable latitude in determining objectives and approaches to assignments.
Key Responsibilities
Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, engineers, and platform teams to understand business objectives, technical requirements, workflows, and success criteria.
Lead technical discovery sessions and translate ambiguous requirements into clear architecture, implementation plans, and engineering deliverables.
Design, develop, test, deploy, and support scalable full-stack applications across web, backend, cloud, data, automation, and AI-enabled use cases.
Build responsive and maintainable front-end applications using modern frameworks such as Vue.js/ React/Angular/Next.js.
Design and implement backend services, APIs, integrations, and microservices using Python
Develop cloud-native solutions using Azure/ Google Cloud Platform/AWS, including compute, storage, identity, networking, serverless, managed databases, monitoring, and logging services.
Build prototypes, proofs of concept, and production-ready solutions for automation, AI-enabled workflows, and digital transformation initiatives.
Integrate AI capabilities into applications using enterprise-approved AI platforms, APIs, SDKs, and cloud AI services.
Design and implement automation solutions for business processes, software delivery, testing, monitoring, reporting, operational support, and developer productivity.
Collaborate with product management and core engineering teams to provide field feedback and influence solution design, platform patterns, and roadmap priorities.
Implement CI/CD pipelines, pipeline code, automated testing, release automation, deployment automation, and environment promotion practices.
Required Qualifications
Use your skills to make an impact
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent/relevant experience in lieu of degree requirement.
Minimum 3 years' experience in full-stack engineering experience designing, building, testing, and supporting modern applications across front-end, back-end, cloud, and DevOps environments.
Minimum 3 years' experience in hands-on experience with modern front-end such as React, Angular, Vue.js, Next.js, React Native, iOS, or Android development patterns.
3+ years' experience in back-end engineering experience with Node.js, .NET, or Java, including RESTful APIs, microservices, event-driven services, authentication, authorization, performance optimization, observability, and error handling.
Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases, cloud platforms, and containerized application environments, including technologies such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes, AKS, GKE, or EKS.
Strong DevOps and secure engineering experience, including Git-based workflows, pull requests, code reviews, CI/CD automation, pipeline-as-code using YAML or equivalent, automated deployments, scripting, code quality tooling, and secure software supply chain practices.
Practical experience applying AI-enabled capabilities to software engineering, automation, application integration, productivity, or business process improvement, including use of APIs, SDKs, cloud AI services, generative AI, LLMs, embeddings, semantic search, or retrieval-augmented generation patterns.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with enterprise API management platforms, API gateway solutions, or large-scale API governance patterns.
Real-world experience using claude code/codex or other assistive coding technology
Experience with GitOps-based deployment models and tools such as ArgoCD.
Work-At-Home Requirements
To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office associates' ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office associates must meet the following criteria:
At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is recommended; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested
Satellite, cellular and microwave connection can be used only if approved by leadership
Associates who live and work from Home in the state of California, Illinois, Montana, or South Dakota will be provided a bi-weekly payment for their internet expense.
Humana will provide Home or Hybrid Home/Office associates with telephone equipment appropriate to meet the business requirements for their position/job.
Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.

Contribute to the design and hands-on implementation of the AI/ML platform that enables Optum to derive information from patient data in a scalable, reliable, and cost-effective manner

Leverage AI assisted tools for design, implementation, code reviews, and testing
Ensure the delivery of high-quality, maintainable, and efficient code and specifications.
Help drive architectural decisions and contribute to our long-term technical strategy for AI/ML systems

Stay ahead of the curve on emerging AI/ML technologies, tools, and research, and evaluate their applicability to business problems. Embrace and promote a culture of innovation through rapid iteration, experimentation and data driven decision-making
Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered solutions to address complex business challenges with emphasis on responsible use of AI

3+ years of AI/ML experience
3+ years of experience in Python programming
2+ years of hands-on experience in modern cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure or Google. GCP is a plus)
1+ years of hands-on experience of CI/CD principles
1+ years of experience leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs)
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or 2+ years of equivalent experience
Proven track record of engaging with customers to design and deliver at least one complete AI product, from ideation to product release
Proven solid knowledge and hands-on experience of CI/CD principles
Proficient with GitHub and GitHub Actions, artifact and dependency management, containerization using Docker, and infrastructure‑as‑code using Terraform to enable reliable, repeatable, and secure deployments
Experience with the challenges of delivering and monitoring LLM based cloud systems into production
Experience in Healthcare
Proven solid communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences
Demonstrated bias for action
Demonstrated passion for innovation and staying current with emerging AI/ML trends

Software Engineers at our company are expected to lead by example, model engineering excellence, and shape both what we build and how we build it.
Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:
We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

Position Description
CGI is actively seeking an AI/ML and Emerging Tech Expert to join our Emerging Technologies Practice and lead the design and delivery of AI driven applications across our Federal Portfolio. You will work end to end—from proofs of concept to production—partnering with solution architects, data scientists, and engineering teams to turn ideas into scalable, secure solutions. This role blends full stack engineering with modern AI/ML, integrating generative AI and advanced analytics within Azure, AWS, and GCP to achieve tangible business outcomes. If you are a creative problem solver who thrives in fast moving, highly collaborative environments, come help us push the boundaries of AI and emerging technologies.
***This position is located in our Fairfax, VA or Lafayette, LA office; however, a hybrid working model is acceptable***
Your future duties and responsibilities
AI/ML Solutioning & Delivery
Design, build, and deploy AI/ML solutions and generative AI applications; architect complex AI pipelines.
Harness large datasets; conduct data mining/analysis; design algorithms and simulations; optimize models for real world performance and cost.
Full Stack Engineering
Implement front end (HTML/CSS/JavaScript; React or Angular) and back end services (Python/Flask/Django; Node.js; Java) that integrate AI capabilities.
Develop robust APIs and microservices; ensure seamless functionality and exceptional UX across platforms.
Cloud & DevSecOps
Deliver against strategic roadmaps for AI and Analytics architectures across Azure, AWS, GCP.
Package and deploy via containerization (Docker, Kubernetes); automate CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab) and IaC (Terraform, AWS CloudFormation).
Establish best practices and patterns for AI & analytics; implement monitoring, observability, and model governance.
Graph Database Development
Design, implement, and optimize GraphDB solutions (e.g., Neo4j, Amazon Neptune) for AI driven applications.
Integrate graph based data models into AI pipelines for knowledge graphs, entity relationships, and semantic search.
Collaboration & Client Engagement
Work closely with data scientists and software engineers to integrate AI into enterprise systems.
Coordinate with client and engineering teams to build, monitor, and maintain solutions.
Support client development opportunities and contribute to thought leadership and demos/POCs.
Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role
Education
Bachelor's (required) or Master's (preferred) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, related field.
Experience
2+ years designing, developing, and deploying AI/ML or advanced software solutions.
Proven experience designing and integrating AI/GenAI into products and enterprise applications.
Demonstrated success delivering full stack solutions that embed AI capabilities.
Hands on experience with GraphDB engineering and development (Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, or similar).
Technical Skills
Programming: Python (expert) plus Java
ML/Deep Learning: TensorFlow, PyTorch; model training, tuning, serving, and monitoring.
Generative AI: hands on with LLMs; prompt engineering; fine tuning; RAG patterns; vector databases.
Web & APIs: HTML/CSS/JS; React or Angular; Node.js/Python/Java back ends; REST/GraphQL.
DevOps/MLOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS CloudFormation; CI/CD with Jenkins/GitLab/Bitbucket; testing frameworks; package managers.
Cloud: Production experience on Azure, AWS, and GCP.
Data: SQL and NoSQL databases; GraphDB; data pipelines; feature stores.
Professional
Excellent problem solving, verbal and written communication.
Ability to work independently and within agile teams.
Strong collaboration skills across cross functional stakeholders.
Desired qualifications/non essential skills required:
Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in AI/ML or related field.
Certifications in Azure/AWS/GCP; Kubernetes, Terraform, or ML specific certifications are a plus.
Deep proficiency in Generative AI, including RAG, LLM orchestration frameworks, and model lifecycle governance.
Portfolio of successful AI projects; evidence of thought leadership (POCs, publications, OSS contributions).
Familiarity with federal sector standards (e.g., secure SDLC, data governance, compliance frameworks) and industry AI use cases.
Strong client facing skills: solution storytelling, demos, and executive level presentations.

title: Machine Learning Engineer Graduate (Conversational AI) - 2027 Start
reason: Stack +59; Title fit +12; Title stack +10; US +10
description_preview:
Responsibilities
Team Introduction:
We build the next-generation unified Agent system for TikTok's global e-Commerce customer service — running in 30+ languages across one of the largest e-Commerce surfaces on the internet.
Our north star is a self-evolving Agent: post-training, harness, memory / context engineering, tools, and evaluation form one closed loop, and every served conversation becomes the next iteration's training / eval / retrieval / skill-induction signal. This loop is already running in production — cases are mined, root-caused, turned into constrained candidates, replayed against frozen regression sets, and shipped behind guardrails.
Two things make this team different from most "LLM application" work:
We build the agent runtime itself — Codex / Claude-Code-class — not prompts on top of a vendor API.
Evaluation and experimentation are first-class systems, not an afterthought. A self-improving loop optimizes whatever signal you give it, so the hardest and most valuable engineering here is making the judgment trustworthy — not just making the model change.
By combining generative recommendation, large recommendation models, multimodal representation learning, and cross-domain value modeling, the team works on some of the most important algorithmic problems in live commerce. Our goal is to improve user experience, optimize ecosystem efficiency, and drive sustainable business growth for TikTok Shop across global markets.
We are looking for talented individuals to join our team. As a graduate, you will get opportunities to pursue bold ideas, tackle complex challenges, and unlock limitless growth. Successful candidates must be able to commit to an onboarding date by the end of the year. Please state your availability and graduation date clearly in your resume. Candidates can apply to a maximum of two positions and will be considered for jobs in the order you apply. The application limit is applicable to our Company and its affiliates' jobs globally. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early.
Responsibilities:
Agent runtime (harness / agent loop). Orchestrate skills, tools, and context; implement loop control & intervention, progressive disclosure, and behavior-level guardrails. Build the production safety layer — pre-flight budgets and timeout truncation, serve-time gates, shadow / swap-in answer delivery, and safe fallback paths.
Context & memory for long multi-turn agents. Agentic memory (structured note-taking), context compaction / summarization, context editing / observation masking, and just-in-time (retrieve-then-load) retrieval. Treat context as an evolving, itemized playbook — with structured diffs and a deterministic curator — rather than an ever-growing prompt.
Post-training & the data flywheel. SFT / DPO / RL to internalize rules into weights (so the prompt gets shorter, not longer), plus distillation to smaller serving models. Turn served conversations into training / eval / retrieval signals.
Tools, Skills, and MCP. Tools-as-APIs, connectors, skill / tool search for large inventories, and skill-library governance — description conflicts, trigger evals, cross-skill mis-fire matrices, and on-demand loading instead of dumping every definition into context.
Evaluation you can bet a launch on. LLM-as-judge with human-agreement calibration; statistical rigor — paired comparison, confidence intervals, repeated sampling, pass^k; held-out and time-rolling eval splits with overfitting alarms; cascaded scoring and cross-family judge panels to make evaluation affordable at scale.
The self-evolving loop. Case mining → automatic root-cause → constrained candidate generation → replay verification against frozen regression sets → canary → flywheel. Build the plumbing that makes it auditable: candidate registry with exact runtime read-back, change lineage, and an archive of rejected candidates you can sample from next round.
Online experimentation & causal readout. Shadow / canary / A-B, non-inferiority gates, traffic-split health, metric definitions that survive scrutiny, and off-policy counterfactual evaluation where live A/B isn't possible.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualification(s):
Individuals who are completing or have recently completed a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or a related discipline
Strong Python plus one of C++ / Go / Rust / Java
Solid ML / DL / NLP fundamentals, with genuine hands-on experience with LLMs or agents (coursework, research, internship, competition, open-source, or a serious side project)
Basic statistical literacy — you can compute a confidence interval, explain what a p-value does and doesn't mean, and tell the difference between "the number went up" and "the system got better"
Able to read a paper or an engineering blog and turn it into working code
Preferred Qualification(s)
Have built the runtime, not just called an API — even at research / hobby / competition scale: your own agent loop / harness, a memory / context-management system, a RAG or tool-use agent, or a fine-tuned / post-trained model
Hands-on experience in any one of the following — depth in one is enough, breadth welcome:
Post-training: SFT / DPO / RLHF / RLAIF / RLVR, reward modeling, reward hacking and how to defend against it
Agent systems: harness, context engineering, MCP / Skills, sub-agents, tool search
Evaluation & experimentation: LLM-as-judge and judge calibration, pass^k, regression suites, A/B and non-inferiority testing, off-policy evaluation
Self-improving / evolutionary systems: evolutionary program search, candidate archives and parent sampling, automatic prompt / context optimization, multi-objective (Pareto) selection and credit assignment
Inference & serving: vLLM / TensorRT-LLM, MoE, KV / prompt caching, and the cost engineering that comes with it
Multilingual NLP
Publications (for PhD), strong competition results (ACM-ICPC / Kaggle / ML competitions), or notable open-s

Position Overview
The Electronics Design Engineer (EDE) is a member of the design and development team of the Instrumentation Design Laboratory at the University of Kansas. The mission of the Laboratory is design and development of custom instruments and computing systems for research groups in engineering and the natural sciences. The EDE applies advanced knowledge of scientific research and engineering principles and practices in broad areas of assignments. The EDE will participate in the joint design, development, and deployment of instrumentation for international collaborations.
Job Description
20%
- Real-Time Programming: Programs will be written for real-time data acquisition and control in an Embedded System environment. Typical platforms use ARM, Atmel AVR devices and Arduino and RPi boards. As skills allow, Field-Programmable Gate Arrays will be supported. A very good understanding of Hardware Description Languages will be required as well as an understanding of the FPGA architecture.
15%
- Electronic Circuit Design: Designs the electronic circuits and systems used in an instrument, utilizing advanced knowledge of design principles and of advanced integrated circuits, programmable logic, and microprocessors. Extremely complex and varied problems will be encountered requiring creativity, foresight, and mature judgment.
15%
- Printed Circuit Board (PCB) Design: Designs and lays out high-performance PCBs. Advanced concepts of layout design are required for achieving very low noise and very high speed, often with controlled-impedance traces. Multi-layer boards (typically 2-6 layers) are required. Boards will be laid out using CAD.
15%
- Fabrication and prototype testing: Electronics components often will be hand-mounted on prototype PCBs. These include high-density integrated circuits. Testing circuits will involve devising test protocols and using oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, etc.
10%
- 3D Computer Aided Design (CAD), modeling and 3d printing for packaging of instrumentation electronics in appropriate mounts and housings will be required.
10%
- Application development for PCs
5%
- Supervision: Engineering technicians and assistants may be assigned tasks on projects being designed and built.
5%
- Multi-institutional Project Development: Participates in multi-institutional planning meetings.
5%
- Completion of other duties as required for the mission of the Instrumentation Design Laboratory.
Required Qualifications
High school/GED and 5 years related experience OR Associate’s degree with 3 years related experience OR Bachelor’s degree with 1 year of related experience OR Master’s degree in Electronics Engineering or related field.
3 years of experience in an engineering research related occupation, including 6 months of experience working with the following: analogue circuit design; digital circuit design; C/C++ programming for embedded systems; printed circuit board layout; high speed data acquisition design; microcontroller such as a PIC series processor; FPGA or CPLD implementation; development of scientific instrumentation; and circuit debugging.
Preferred Qualifications
Radio frequency design experience.
Experience with microcontroller-implemented designs.
Programming skills in the following languages: C/C++, C#, LabVIEW, MatLab/Simulink, Python.
Experience with development of scientific instrumentation.
Experience in a basic science research laboratory.

You will contribute Python-based tooling, test automation scripts, analysis utilities, and documentation that help autonomy and systems developers run tests, understand simulation results, and identify software issues.

Help build and maintain automated test workflows and wrappers around HMS Forge and other internal test-orchestration tools.
Assist with developing program-specific test adapters, configuration files, and automation utilities in Python and, when needed, C++.
Contribute to programmatic scenario-generation tools that create varied simulation conditions for testing autonomy behaviors.
Write and maintain domain-randomization scripts that vary environmental, vehicle, sensor, mission, or operational parameters across test runs.
Investigate test failures and simulation issues by reviewing logs, configuration files, telemetry, rosbags, network captures, and automated test results.
Help improve repeatability and consistency in simulation testing by maintaining reusable test templates, common analysis utilities, and standardized reporting outputs.
Assist with containerized development and testing environments using tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, and related infrastructure tooling.
Contribute to prototype configurations for distributed testing and batch simulation runs, including Terraform, Kubernetes manifests, or similar deployment configurations.
Help maintain stable development workflows by supporting source-control practices, dependency updates, CI/CD pipelines, and software build troubleshooting.
Create clear developer documentation, setup guides, API references, example workflows, and workspace templates for engineers using automated simulation-test tools.
Participate in code reviews, design discussions, test reviews, and collaborative debugging sessions with autonomy, simulation, platform, and program teams.

Understanding of core software-engineering practices, including Git-based version control, code review, automated testing, and debugging.

QA Engineer II - Role Overview
We are seeking an Intermediate Accessibility QA Engineer to validate and improve the accessibility of our platforms. In this role candidate will test complex, real-time interactive components such as dynamic comboboxes, auto-suggestions, voice-input controls and rich media snippet cards to guarantee full compliance with WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA standards.
Key Responsibilities
4+ years of dedicated experience in digital accessibility testing and QA
Conduct manual accessibility evaluations on dynamic elements, including dynamic dropdowns, live region announcements, query filter chips, and pagination/infinite scroll.
Perform end-to-end user flow testing using screen readers (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver on macOS/iOS, TalkBack on Android) and keyboard-only navigation.
Verify keyboard focus indicators, logical tab ordering, search landmark usage, and "Skip to Search Results" shortcut implementations.
Run automated accessibility scans using tools like axe DevTools, Lighthouse, and Accessibility Insights; assist in maintaining automated axe-core test suites in the CI/CD pipeline.
Log high-quality bug reports with exact reproduction steps, impact severity on users with disabilities, and code-level remediation recommendations (HTML semantics, ARIA attributes).
Partner with frontend engineers and UX designers during sprint planning and PR reviews to catch accessibility regressions early.
Solid working knowledge of WCAG 2.1/2.2 Level A and AA criteria, Section 508, and WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices Guide (APG).
Clear understanding of how to test and validate complex interactive widgets like Combobox, Listbox, Dialogs, Tooltips, and ARIA Live Regions.
Hands-on proficiency testing across primary browser and screen reader combinations (Chrome/NVDA, Edge/JAWS, Safari/VoiceOver, Chrome/TalkBack).
Ability to inspect the DOM, evaluate color contrast ratios, check accessible names in DevTools, and read basic HTML/CSS/JavaScript.
2–4 years of software testing experience, with at least 2 years focused specifically on web/mobile accessibility QA.

Project Engineers in this role will have the opportunity for on-site functional rotations between the Advanced Operations, R&D, Quality and Operations organization, gaining highly valuable experience in key areas of Device Manufacturing Business. As a program participant, graduates will begin their journey with Advanced Operations, then rotate through two other functional areas before returning to Advanced Operations.
Advanced Operations (AO)
AO plays a critical role in Stryker that interfaces between R&D activities and manufacturing, translating design requirements into manufacturing and process requirements and designs and specifies the manufacturing process for either internal manufacturing or external manufacturing partnership.
Rotations may include two of the following:
Supply Chain Optimization
The function of the Supply Chain Optimization organization is to unlock value, reduce supply risk and streamline our current production chains through use of manufacturing transfer. Team members will perform due diligence and provide manufacturability assessments on product transfers to both Stryker production facilities and strategic suppliers. Team members will also work with our global partners and senior leaders by creating in-depth scoping plans and cost-benefit analyses that drive business excellence and both top and bottom-line growth.
Quality
At Stryker, Quality always comes first. Whether it is new product development or sustaining existing products, Quality Engineers are the voice of quality for Stryker. They are responsible for reliability engineering, human factors engineering, risk management, design validation and more, while ensuring compliance to FDA Quality System Regulations and ISO 13485.
Operations
Manufacturing Engineers are key players in supporting Manufacturing and Operations of Stryker products. The function focuses on opportunities to increase capacity, reduce scrap, improve safety, monitor existing processes, and identify and implement process improvements while adhering to medical device manufacturing regulations.

Support capital acquisition activities.

Conduct MSA studies for new products and new processes.
Provide training for manufacturing team members.
Ensure adherence to GMP and safety procedures.

Description
At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.
Northrop Grumman is a space pioneer, supporting government, civil and commercial customers in solving their biggest challenges. Our forward-leaning, innovative spirit is backed by a legacy of expertise that began at the dawn of the space age. Our mission experience in space runs deep, we know our customers well, and our capabilities are unmatched. This is what allows us to provide reliable, agile and affordable space solutions to best serve our customers. From defending freedom to advancing human discovery, we are defining what is possible in space every day.
Entry Level opportunities at Northrop Grumman are unique. Are you interested in boosting your knowledge through experience and exposure, while supporting a mission that seeks to protect our nation and its allies? If so, then Northrop Grumman is the place you!
Our professionals live and breathe different perspectives; we are curious about the world, accepting each other, and aware that the more ideas, backgrounds, opinions and experiences we bring to our work, the stronger that work will be. Just as you would invest your time and hard work into our company, we focus on investing back into you through enriching professional experiences and high-quality learning and development opportunities. We want you to bring your whole self to work, and for you to have meaningful connections with your coworkers, customers and communities, while providing the best products, systems and technologies to protect our world.
Northrop Grumman is seeking Associate Propulsion Engineers and Propulsion Engineers. This position will be located at our Space sector in Promontory, UT. May also consider candidates in Clearfield, UT; Salt Lake City, UT; or Magna, UT.
The Qualified Candidate Will Become Part Of Northrop Grumman's Propulsion Engineering Team In Support Of One Or More Of The Following Engineering Functions
Design and Analysis Engineering
Material Science Engineering
Product Development Engineering
Test and Integration Engineering
Responsibilities
As a Propulsion Engineer, you will:
Assist in the development and analysis of propulsion system components, including rocket motors, nozzles, materials and propellant grains.
Perform engineering calculations and simulations to predict propulsion system performance including CFD, thermal response and structural integrity.
Support the design, execution and documentation of propulsion system tests, including data acquisition and post-test analysis.
Contribute to technical documentation such as design specifications, 3D CAD models and drawings, test plans and engineering reports.
Collaborate with senior engineers and interdisciplinary teams and experts to ensure successful project execution.
Participate in root cause analysis and corrective action planning for propulsion system issues.
Participate in design reviews and collaborate with cross-functional teams including engineers using the propulsion within the targeted system.
Maintain awareness of industry standards, best practices, and emerging technologies in propulsion engineering.
Help implement collaborative engineering processes across multiple engineering disciplines to optimize design performance and achieve required cost and manufacturing rate objectives.
Work with senior engineers to evaluate manufacturing and product defects against required performance and identify improvement actions.
Evaluate supply chain items and materials for suitability in designs and production, supporting required levels of quality and performance (often using Statistical Process Control tools)
Basic Qualifications
Basic Qualifications for an Associate Propulsion Engineer:
Completing or has completed a Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution
Major in Mechanical, Chemical, Material Science or Aerospace Engineering or related STEM field
Ability to obtain a U.S. Government security clearance (U.S. citizenship is a pre-requisite)
Ability to obtain Special Access Program access within a reasonable period of time, as determined by the company to meet its business needs
Basic Qualifications For a Propulsion Engineer
Completing or has completed a Master’s degree from an accredited institution
Major in Mechanical, Chemical, Material Science or Aerospace Engineering or related STEM field
Ability to obtain a U.S. Government security clearance (U.S. citizenship is a pre-requisite)
Ability to obtain Special Access Program access within a reasonable period of time, as determined by the company to meet its business needs
Preferred Qualifications For Both Levels
Internships or co-op experience in aerospace, defense or propulsion.
Hands on experience with engineering tools such as ANSYS/CFD, MATLAB, Python and CAD.
Experience with energetics, rockets or chemical propulsion in school projects (e.g., rocketry clubs, coursework or capstone assignments)
Have an overall cumulative GPA of 3.0/4.0 or higher
Salary Range
Associate Propulsion Engineer: $65,800 to $98,800
Propulsion Engineer: $ 79,300 to $118,900

Primary Level Salary Range: $65,800.00 - $98,800.00
